requirements.title: Dummy argument presence and absence are defined by actual argument status
requirements.definition: A dummy argument, and any entity host associated with it, is not present for omitted actual arguments, absent actual dummies, unallocated allocatable actuals for nonallocatable dummies, and disassociated pointer actuals for nonpointer dummies; otherwise it is present.

pending.absent-actual-propagates-not-present: Cross-reference the S16.9.163-003 pass-through absent optional dummy plan, which cites 15.5.2.13 p1 and p4.
pending.unallocated-allocatable-actual-not-prese: Extend the future PRESENT packet with an unallocated allocatable actual passed to an ordinary optional dummy, logical sentinel initialized true, and exact false result.
pending.disassociated-pointer-actual-not-present: Extend the future PRESENT packet with a disassociated pointer actual passed to an ordinary optional dummy, logical sentinel initialized true, and exact false result.
pending.otherwise-dummy-present: Cross-reference the planned PRESENT supplied-argument true call in S16.9.163-003 and add allocatable allocated plus pointer associated variants only there.

requirements.title: Nonoptional dummies are present and present pointer actual status is defined
requirements.definition: A nonoptional dummy argument shall be present; an optional nonpointer dummy corresponding to a present pointer actual argument requires the actual pointer association status not to be undefined.

pending.nonoptional-dummy-present: Positive source control supplies every nonoptional dummy and verifies the callee writes an exact marker 31. A mutation omits the required actual solely as a program-restriction contrast; no diagnostic facet is claimed.
pending.present-pointer-actual-status-defined: Use only definitely associated or definitely disassociated pointer actuals in executable plans. No portable oracle can create and then observe undefined pointer association status without already leaving the conforming subset.

requirements.title: Absent optional dummy arguments have restricted uses
requirements.definition: An optional dummy argument that is not present is subject to the listed restrictions on reference, definition, pointer assignment targets, invocation, actual-argument forwarding, subobject actuals, elemental procedure actuals, pointer operations, allocatable operations, length-parameter inquiry, construct selectors, procedure-designator data-refs, and proc-component-ref scalar variables.

pending.absent-data-object-not-referenced-or-def: Conforming source controls branch on PRESENT before reference or definition and set marker 41 only along the present path. A mutation removes the guard; no diagnostic facet is claimed.
pending.absent-no-pointer-assignment-target: Conforming source controls perform pointer assignment only after PRESENT is true; absent-path mutation is retained only as source-control material.
pending.absent-procedure-not-invoked: Conforming source controls call an optional dummy procedure only after PRESENT is true and use a 43 result sentinel; absent invocation remains a nonconforming contrast without diagnostic expectation.
pending.absent-not-forwarded-to-nonoptional-exce: Cross-reference S16.9.163-003 for PRESENT pass-through. Also compile a procedure with optional integer dummy x and a declaration integer, parameter :: k = kind(x); KIND is an inquiry intrinsic function reference that is a constant expression, so x is permitted as that nonoptional actual and k equals KIND(0). Ordinary nonoptional forwarding remains a source-control negative with no diagnostic facet.
pending.absent-subobject-not-actual: Conforming source controls avoid subobject selectors before forwarding optional dummies; selector forwarding of an absent base is nonconforming contrast only.
pending.absent-array-elemental-forwarding-restri: Conforming elemental forwarding supplies a same-rank nonoptional array companion before forwarding the absent optional array. A mutation drops the companion and remains source-control only.
pending.absent-pointer-operations-restricted: Executable plans allocate, deallocate, nullify, pointer-assign, or forward pointer optional dummies only along a PRESENT-true path; absent-path operations have no portable oracle.
pending.absent-allocatable-operations-restricted: Executable plans allocate, deallocate, or forward allocatable optional dummies only along a PRESENT-true path; absent-path operations have no portable oracle.
pending.absent-length-parameter-not-inquired: Conforming controls inquire LEN only after PRESENT is true; absent inquiry cannot be used as a portable executable oracle.
pending.absent-not-construct-selector: Conforming controls enter ASSOCIATE, CHANGE TEAM, SELECT RANK, or SELECT TYPE selectors only with present dummies; absent selectors are source-control contrasts.
pending.absent-not-procedure-designator-data-ref: Conforming controls avoid procedure-designator data-ref use for absent optional dummies; nonconforming use has no required diagnostic here.
pending.absent-not-proc-component-ref-scalar-var: Conforming controls use proc-component-ref scalar variables only for present optional dummies; absent use remains source-control material.
